systems.name: Systems of Record
systems.description: Notion, Google Drive, local files, and meeting exports remain authoritative for source content. Knowledge OS holds derived context with provenance.
responsibilities: Supply source revisions and authorization observations. Receive mutations only through an independently authorized, governed Action adapter.
inputs: User-authored source content and source-side sharing decisions.
outputs: Provider snapshots, file bytes, revision metadata, and ACL observations.
owns: Original source records outside Knowledge OS.
invariants: Source content is not silently rewritten by ingestion. Derived knowledge never replaces the source of record.
gaps: External sharing semantics are provider-specific; Notion does not claim complete human/group ACL parity.

source.name: Source Registry
source.description: Source records identify a workspace-scoped source collection and its bound connector instance; this is part of GraphStore, not a separate registry service.
responsibilities: Bind source identity and checkpoint state so retries and source catalogs refer to the same collection.
inputs: Workspace, source type, opaque external ID, connector ID.
outputs: Stable Source identity and authorized catalog/checkpoint summaries.
owns: Source node, connector binding, committed sync cursor.
invariants: A different connector cannot silently take ownership. Item ingestion does not independently advance a completed-run checkpoint.

connectors.name: Connectors
connectors.description: Filesystem, Google Drive, and Notion adapters translate provider-specific observations into the provider-neutral manifest contract.
responsibilities: Complete the inventory before declaring deletions. Write local connector checkpoints only after the graph commit succeeds.
inputs: Provider inventory, source authorization, previous connector checkpoint.
outputs: Deterministic UPSERT/TOMBSTONE manifest and proposed next checkpoint.
owns: Adapter-local checkpoint files; no canonical semantic truth.
invariants: Retries must reproduce the same semantic state. Provider failures must not be interpreted as an empty successful inventory.

parsing.name: Parsing
parsing.description: File extraction produces text and a parser version. Provider adapters flatten supported source structures before manifest ingestion.
responsibilities: Retain useful evidence text and source provenance while normalizing supported document formats.
inputs: Supported file bytes or provider blocks and properties.
outputs: Text, title, URI, and parser version.
owns: No independent store; text is passed to ingestion.
invariants: Processing versions contribute to evidence identity. Transcript timestamps remain part of the evidence text.
gaps: Parser fidelity is format-specific; the repository does not demonstrate every external exporter.

ingestion.name: Ingestion
ingestion.description: Text, manifests, tombstones, and checkpoints enter the existing GraphStore transaction boundary through REST or local connector commands.
responsibilities: Create immutable evidence versions and preserve replay identity. Atomically commit complete manifests under Source serialization.
inputs: Typed text requests or ordered manifest records with authorization and processing metadata.
outputs: Document/version/Chunk identities, tombstone Events, and committed checkpoints.
owns: Evidence lifecycle and source-run completion records in Neo4j.
invariants: Compare-and-set protects current versions and cursors. Failed manifests roll back earlier records and the checkpoint. F1/F2 corrections do not establish full release acceptance.

document.name: Document
document.description: The stable document identity links a source record to its current version and retained historical versions.
responsibilities: Provide the lifecycle and CURRENT_VERSION anchor without overwriting historical evidence.
inputs: Source identity plus external document ID.
outputs: Stable document ID, current-version pointer, version history.
owns: Document identity, active/deleted lifecycle, current-version relationship.
invariants: Identity is workspace/source scoped. A tombstone retains version history; direct updates require the current version precondition.

version.name: DocumentVersion
version.description: An immutable source/processing/authorization snapshot preserves the exact provenance of a document at ingestion.
responsibilities: Separate changed source observations from stable Document identity and maintain supersession lineage.
inputs: Content, source revision, metadata, ACL snapshot, parser/chunker contract.
outputs: Content-addressed version identity and version-linked evidence Chunks.
owns: Historical metadata, authorization snapshot, hashes, processing provenance.
invariants: Metadata hashes must match persisted title/URI. Reusing one source revision with conflicting metadata fails closed. Historical ACLs are provenance, not permanent read grants.

chunking.name: Chunking
chunking.description: The paragraph-v1 split_text function turns normalized source text into retrieval-sized evidence units within the ingestion module.
responsibilities: Create deterministic evidence boundaries that remain attributable to a DocumentVersion.
inputs: Extracted text and declared chunk_size.
outputs: Ordered text chunks.
owns: No separate service or store.
invariants: Do not lose evidence to satisfy a size bound. F6 records that long paragraphs exceed the intended hard limit.

chunk.name: Chunk
chunk.description: The exact evidence unit used by retrieval, evidence bundles, and governed proposals; each Chunk belongs to a historical DocumentVersion.
responsibilities: Give claims stable, inspectable support and expose evidence only under current source authorization.
inputs: Version identity, chunk order, text, processing metadata.
outputs: Authorized exact evidence and retrieval candidates.
owns: Evidence text, version link, lifecycle flags, optional embedding provenance.
invariants: Current ACL and active Document lifecycle govern reads. Historical Chunk provenance is retained even when its source is deleted.

embedding.name: Embedding
embedding.description: Existing interfaces accept caller-supplied vectors with model/version provenance. This is contract support, not an active production embedding provider.
responsibilities: Annotate authorized current Chunks with immutable vector provenance for model-isolated retrieval.
inputs: Chunk ID, vector, model/version, authenticated access context.
outputs: Idempotent embedding annotation or rejection of a conflicting payload.
owns: Embedding vector and fingerprint on the existing Chunk.
invariants: Only current active authorized evidence can be annotated. A different payload cannot silently overwrite an embedding.
deferrals: Production provider activation is deferred; the historical personal snapshot has no populated current Chunk vectors.

extraction.name: Extraction
extraction.description: Versioned assertion, Decision, and Event prompts plus ontology context guide external candidate generation. Automated extraction providers are deferred.
responsibilities: Make extraction context discoverable while ensuring all proposed knowledge enters governed review.
inputs: Authorized evidence bundle, ontology version, prompt version/checksum.
outputs: Typed Proposal candidates from replaceable adapters.
owns: Git-controlled prompts; candidates persist through Proposal contracts.
invariants: Prompt output never directly becomes canonical knowledge. No model SDK or autonomous extraction pipeline is implied.
deferrals: Automated extraction provider and production embedding provider integrations.

ontology.name: Ontology
ontology.description: The Git-controlled vocabulary specifies entity types and allowed subject/object relation combinations for candidate validation.
responsibilities: Keep semantic names and relationship constraints explicit and versioned.
inputs: EntityRef and AssertionChange candidates.
outputs: Validated typed relations or a validation error.
owns: config/ontology.yaml version and vocabulary.
invariants: Unknown types and object relations must be rejected. F5 tracks the scalar-value path bypassing predicate validation.

resolution.name: Entity Resolution
resolution.description: Approval derives Entity IDs from workspace, entity type, and case-folded name, then merges those IDs. This is deterministic identity matching, not fuzzy entity resolution.
responsibilities: Reuse named entities within the approved canonical graph and preserve subject identity during Assertion correction.
inputs: Approved subject/object EntityRef values.
outputs: Stable Entity IDs and canonical merges.
owns: No separate resolver database or provider.
invariants: Identity is scoped by workspace/type/name. Aliases do not establish an implemented fuzzy matching system.
gaps: No dedicated real-world disambiguation quality benchmark or automatic alias reconciliation was found.

governance.name: Proposal / Approval
governance.description: Proposals collect candidate knowledge and exact evidence. A separate authenticated review decision either rejects them or promotes canonical records.
responsibilities: Separate extraction from truth and preserve immutable review outcomes. Revalidate evidence access inside the write transaction.
inputs: Typed candidates, creator access context, reviewer identity and decision.
outputs: One immutable approval/rejection outcome and, on approval, canonical records.
owns: Proposal identity/payload, SUPPORTED_BY lineage, Approval history.
invariants: MCP cannot approve or reject. A pending proposal cannot acquire conflicting review outcomes. Authorization uses current evidence ACLs.

entity.name: Entity
entity.description: A canonical typed participant or concept shared by approved Assertions, Events, and Decisions.
responsibilities: Provide stable points for evidence-backed discovery and graph-neighbor reads.
inputs: Approved EntityRef values and evidence-backed canonical relations.
outputs: Authorized entity summaries and neighbors.
owns: Canonical name/type/aliases and workspace membership.
invariants: Discovery requires related authorized evidence; a known ID does not grant access. Runtime VERIFIED labels describe knowledge status, not Explorer implementation verification.

assertion.name: Assertion
assertion.description: An approved claim connects a subject to an object or scalar value with exact evidence and temporal validity.
responsibilities: Represent inspectable semantic claims and retain correction/supersession history.
inputs: An approved AssertionChange with evidence, predicate and temporal fields.
outputs: Canonical Assertion reads and graph relationships.
owns: Claim predicate/value, evidence link, confidence, temporal and extraction provenance.
invariants: Canonical promotion requires approval. A superseding assertion preserves subject and predicate and must not silently erase its predecessor.
gaps: Temporal supersession regression cases are present; this milestone does not claim the release gate passed.

event.name: Event
event.description: Events record semantic occurrences and operational provenance, distinguished by event_class. Only semantic Events use candidate review.
responsibilities: Preserve occurrence/correction history and source synchronization or deletion observations without conflating those meanings.
inputs: Approved Event proposal or a source operation.
outputs: Semantic Event reads or operational source history.
owns: Occurrence and recording times, participants/evidence or source parent linkage.
invariants: Operational Events have exactly one Source/Document provenance parent. Source deletion observations retain source timestamps separately from local recording time.

decision.name: Decision
decision.description: An approved human or organizational Decision preserves evidence, participants, temporal validity, and supersession.
responsibilities: Make decision history retrievable without treating extraction or operational logs as human decisions.
inputs: Governed DecisionProposalCreate and supporting evidence.
outputs: Authorized canonical Decision, optionally as of a specified time.
owns: Decision payload, participants, evidence, temporal validity, predecessor lineage.
invariants: A later decision supersedes rather than overwrites. Access depends on current authorization to all supporting evidence.

action.name: Action
action.description: A governed request for a bounded external capability. Approval does not execute it; a separately authorized adapter claims execution and records immutable results.
responsibilities: Keep operational writes behind policy, reviewer, capability, lease, and source-system authorization boundaries.
inputs: Action request, designated reviewers/executors, policy version, explicit approval.
outputs: Execution claim, provider operation, and immutable execution evidence.
owns: Action snapshots, review decisions, claim lease and execution records in Neo4j.
invariants: MCP cannot approve or execute. A lease expiry is not takeover permission. External exactly-once delivery is not guaranteed if the provider ignores idempotency. F4/F8 remain open.

neo4j.name: Neo4j
neo4j.description: The local graph stores source lineage, approved knowledge, governance, and retrieval indexes as the System of Context.
responsibilities: Keep graph/evidence relationships and transactional transitions in one existing persistence boundary.
inputs: Governed GraphStore writes and versioned migrations.
outputs: Authorized evidence, canonical reads, search results and operational provenance.
owns: Context graph, full-text/vector indexes, migration ledger.
invariants: Original Systems of Record remain authoritative. No external vector store or second knowledge database is introduced.

vector.name: Vector Index
vector.description: Neo4j chunk_embedding_vector indexes 1,536-dimensional Chunk embeddings with model/version and active filters.
responsibilities: Provide semantic candidates inside the existing graph store.
inputs: Authorized current Chunk vectors with model/version metadata.
outputs: Filtered semantic search candidates.
owns: A Neo4j index over Chunk embeddings.
invariants: Do not change dimensionality merely to activate a provider. Model/version provenance must match the query. Index availability does not imply populated vectors.

fulltext.name: Full-text Index
fulltext.description: Neo4j indexes Chunk text/section and Entity name/description for keyword and entity discovery.
responsibilities: Supply native indexed candidates for authorized search without another search service.
inputs: Indexed Chunk/Entity text and literalized query tokens.
outputs: Keyword and entity candidate rows.
owns: chunk_text_fulltext and entity_name_fulltext indexes.
invariants: User search text cannot become Lucene query syntax. Candidate ranking does not bypass source authorization.

graph-retrieval.name: Graph Retrieval
graph-retrieval.description: Authorized entity discovery, neighbor traversal, and canonical record reads expose bounded graph context through stable service contracts.
responsibilities: Connect retrieved evidence to approved semantic relationships while preserving access and temporal constraints.
inputs: Entity/record IDs or discovery query, access context, optional as-of time.
outputs: Bounded authorized canonical records and traced discovery results.
owns: No separate database; retrieval traces belong to the operations store.
invariants: Known IDs do not bypass ACLs. Canonical reads require all supporting evidence to remain accessible.

api.name: Knowledge API
api.description: The FastAPI REST surface exposes the stable contracts; endpoint transport is a replaceable adapter around the Knowledge Service implementation.
responsibilities: Validate typed requests, apply access context and expose bounded service capabilities.
inputs: REST requests with adapter-derived authenticated identity.
outputs: Contract responses, deliberate denials, traces, and bounded errors.
owns: No independent store. GraphStore and OpsStore own persistence.
invariants: Authentication belongs to the edge adapter. Caller display names alone never authorize governance. Stable contracts are authoritative over transport choices.
gaps: This local boundary must not be represented as a separately demonstrated enterprise authentication deployment.

mcp.name: MCP
mcp.description: A stdio MCP adapter projects authorized reads and governed Proposal/Action requests through the Knowledge Service using host-fixed identities.
responsibilities: Let agent clients consume context and request review without receiving direct database authority.
inputs: Bounded MCP tool arguments plus host-owned workspace/principals.
outputs: Knowledge Service results or governed request receipts.
owns: Host adapter configuration only; no independent knowledge store.
invariants: No direct Cypher, ingestion, approval, Action execution or external mutation tools. MCP is not entirely read-only: it can submit governed requests.

telemetry.name: Telemetry / Evaluation
telemetry.description: Bounded telemetry, traces, feedback, evaluation results, audits, and safe errors support measured correctness and retrieval quality work.
responsibilities: Record operational evidence without becoming canonical knowledge or leaking raw principals and source payloads into error records.
inputs: Adapter timings, access-bound trace IDs, evaluation cases and feedback.
outputs: Operational rows, measured retrieval metrics and diagnostic records.
owns: Evidence of operations in the existing local SQLite store.
invariants: Authorization-denial cases must fail on leaked results before exclusions; F7 remains open. Cross-store graph/audit recovery is not a distributed transaction; F8 remains open.

sqlite.name: SQLite Operations
sqlite.description: The existing local SQLite database stores telemetry, audit, traces, evaluations, feedback, and safe operational errors.
responsibilities: Keep local operational evidence outside the canonical context graph with minimal infrastructure.
inputs: Bounded application observations and trace-linked evaluation/feedback.
outputs: Operational diagnostics and online backup artifact.
owns: Operations tables only; no source document or canonical knowledge store.
invariants: Operations data cannot promote canonical truth. Graph commits and SQLite writes do not form one atomic distributed transaction.

migration.name: Migration
migration.description: Numbered Cypher files define the graph constraints/indexes and explicit lineage/provenance backfills; checksums protect the applied ledger.
responsibilities: Evolve schema explicitly and detect missing, changed, or unexpected migrations.
inputs: Git-owned Cypher files and current SchemaMigration ledger.
outputs: Applied schema/backfill operations and recorded checksums.
owns: SchemaMigration records in Neo4j; migration files remain authoritative in Git.
invariants: Applied migrations are never edited silently. Explorer checks read migration files but never execute them.

recovery.name: Backup / Recovery
recovery.description: A recovery set combines an official Neo4j backup, SQLite online backup, contract/Git provenance and artifact hashes.
responsibilities: Make recovery inspectable and verify artifacts without treating the cross-store capture window as a distributed transaction.
inputs: Existing graph and operations stores plus explicit administrative backup tooling.
outputs: Recovery manifest, database artifacts, hashes, verification results.
owns: Protected local backup files outside committed documentation.
invariants: Verify hashes and archive consistency before restore. Local same-DBMS restore evidence does not establish host-loss recovery or off-device retention.
gaps: Host-loss recovery and off-device retention remain outside recorded proof.

proposal.name: Proposal
proposal.description: A content-addressed candidate for Assertion, Decision, or Event knowledge.
responsibilities: Preserve proposed payload and complete evidence before human review.
inputs: Candidate, creator identity, ontology version.
outputs: Reviewable immutable candidate identity.
owns: Payload hash and SUPPORTED_BY Chunk links.
invariants: Retries do not reopen approved or rejected payloads.

approval.name: Approval
approval.description: An immutable decision owned by one Proposal or Action.
responsibilities: Record the authenticated human decision and its provenance.
inputs: Review identity, decision, reason and authorized evidence.
outputs: One approval/rejection outcome.
owns: Decision record with exactly one governance parent.
invariants: Approval does not itself execute an external Action.

doctor.name: Read-only Doctor
doctor.description: Integrity checks inspect graph lineage, migration/index state, and operational provenance.
responsibilities: Detect violations without normalizing away history.
inputs: Existing graph, migration files, operations store.
outputs: Bounded integrity report.
owns: No repair state.
invariants: Detection is separate from correction. F3 has unresolved coverage and compatibility cases.

files.name: Filesystem Connector
files.description: A source-specific adapter producing the common atomic manifest contract.
responsibilities: Translate a complete source inventory and prior checkpoint into deterministic observations.
inputs: Authorized inventory and prior connector state.
outputs: Manifest and next checkpoint.
owns: Local source-bound checkpoint.
invariants: No checkpoint advancement before successful graph commit; preserve provider-specific provenance and ACL limitations.

drive.name: Google Drive Connector
drive.description: A source-specific adapter producing the common atomic manifest contract.
responsibilities: Translate a complete source inventory and prior checkpoint into deterministic observations.
inputs: Authorized inventory and prior connector state.
outputs: Manifest and next checkpoint.
owns: Local source-bound checkpoint.
invariants: No checkpoint advancement before successful graph commit; preserve provider-specific provenance and ACL limitations.

notion.name: Notion Connector
notion.description: A source-specific adapter producing the common atomic manifest contract.
responsibilities: Translate a complete source inventory and prior checkpoint into deterministic observations.
inputs: Authorized inventory and prior connector state.
outputs: Manifest and next checkpoint.
owns: Local source-bound checkpoint.
invariants: No checkpoint advancement before successful graph commit; preserve provider-specific provenance and ACL limitations.

keyword.name: Keyword / Hybrid Retrieval
keyword.description: Literal full-text search uses bounded title reranking and hybrid rank fusion when a compatible query embedding is supplied.
responsibilities: Make ranking explainable and model isolation explicit.
inputs: Query, mode, access context and optional vector/model/version.
outputs: Ranked evidence and trace ID.
owns: No additional index service.
invariants: Fusion cannot discard authorization requirements.

provider.name: Production Embedding Provider
provider.description: Production vector population is deliberately inactive pending provider acceptance.
responsibilities: Keep measured provider selection separate from supported semantic contracts.
inputs: New provider evaluation and authorized corpus.
outputs: No activated production provider in this scope.
owns: No new provider deployment.
invariants: An online vector index alone does not prove semantic readiness.
deferrals: Requires fresh acceptance evidence before production population.

automated-extraction.name: Automated Extraction Provider
automated-extraction.description: An automated provider is intentionally deferred; prompt and Proposal contracts already exist.
responsibilities: Reserve candidate generation behind the governed interface.
inputs: A separately justified provider capability.
outputs: No automated extraction runtime in v1.
owns: None.
invariants: Extracted output cannot bypass review.

future-adapters.name: A2A / Product UI
future-adapters.description: Production A2A integration and a product-facing custom graph UI remain deferred. This Explorer is removable developer documentation.
responsibilities: Keep replaceable adapters from redefining stable architecture.
inputs: A separately requested measured capability requirement.
outputs: No production adapter in this milestone.
owns: None.
invariants: The Explorer is not a runtime dependency or a product feature.

contract-source.name: Source Contract
contract-source.description: Source identity, connector observations, versions, deletion and checkpoint semantics.
responsibilities: Define the stable architectural boundary independently of REST, MCP, storage adapters or UI.
inputs: Provider observations with stable identity and authorization.
outputs: Versioned evidence and committed source-run history.
owns: Source contract version; runtime data lives in Neo4j.
invariants: Provider retries must not duplicate semantic state.

contract-evidence.name: Evidence Contract
contract-evidence.description: Exact authorized evidence with immutable DocumentVersion and Source provenance.
responsibilities: Define the stable architectural boundary independently of REST, MCP, storage adapters or UI.
inputs: Stable Chunk IDs and current access context.
outputs: Bounded all-or-nothing evidence bundles.
owns: Evidence contract version.
invariants: Historical ACL snapshots never replace current authorization.

contract-knowledge.name: Knowledge Contract
contract-knowledge.description: Canonical Entity, Assertion, Event and Decision reads plus extraction context discovery.
responsibilities: Define the stable architectural boundary independently of REST, MCP, storage adapters or UI.
inputs: Record IDs, query context, ontology/prompt names.
outputs: Authorized semantic records and versioned extraction context.
owns: Knowledge contract version.
invariants: Knowledge requires approved provenance; adapters cannot redefine canonical truth.

contract-governance.name: Governance Contract
contract-governance.description: Candidate validation, authenticated review, rejection and promotion.
responsibilities: Define the stable architectural boundary independently of REST, MCP, storage adapters or UI.
inputs: Evidence-backed candidates and explicit reviewer context.
outputs: Immutable decisions and approved canonical records.
owns: Governance contract version.
invariants: Proposal → validation → Approval/rejection → canonical graph.

contract-retrieval.name: Retrieval Contract
contract-retrieval.description: Keyword, vector, hybrid and graph discovery with access-bound operational evidence.
responsibilities: Define the stable architectural boundary independently of REST, MCP, storage adapters or UI.
inputs: Queries, exact model/version when semantic, authenticated access.
outputs: Bounded ranked context, capabilities, traces and evaluation evidence.
owns: Retrieval contract version.
invariants: Ranking and vector search do not bypass evidence authorization.

contract-action.name: Action Contract
contract-action.description: Governed capability creation, review, claims and execution evidence.
responsibilities: Define the stable architectural boundary independently of REST, MCP, storage adapters or UI.
inputs: Explicit capability/policy, principals and source-system authorization.
outputs: Approved request, bounded claim and immutable execution records.
owns: Action contract version.
invariants: External writes occur only through separately authenticated, authorized adapters.
